subject: general
question: Which of the following ‘V’ blocks will have one ‘V’ groove and two grooves (slots) on either side for clamping in two positions?
solution:
The correct answer is __Single level double groove ‘V’ block.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Single level double groove ‘V’ block__ is designed with one ‘V’ groove and two grooves (slots) on either side.
 
• It allows clamping in two positions for versatile machining applications.
 
• These blocks are commonly used in precision tasks involving cylindrical workpieces.
 
• They are made of hardened steel to ensure durability and accuracy.
 
• The design facilitates stable placement of the workpiece during machining or inspection.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Single level single groove ‘V’ block:**

 
 
• It has a single ‘V’ groove for holding cylindrical objects.
 
• Used in situations where fewer clamping positions are required.
 
 
 
• **Double level single groove ‘V’ block:**
 
 
• It offers two levels, enhancing workpiece handling flexibility.
 
• Primarily used in complex machining setups.
 
 
 
• **Matched pair ‘V’ block:**
 
 
• Comes in pairs for precision alignment of cylindrical parts.
 
• Ideal for inspection or grinding operations requiring dual support points.
